This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is second application on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail.
The first application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 01.11.2022 passed in MCRC No. 48917/2022 with liberty file a fresh one after recording the statement of prosecutrix.

Applicant is in custody since 30.07.2022 in connection with Crime No. 187/2022 registered at Police Station Tala, District Satna for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 450 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of the POCSO Act.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the statements of prosecutrix and her mother and father have been recorded in the court and they have been declared hostile as they have not supported the case of the prosecution and therefore applicant may be released on bail.
Considering the aforesaid
, though the application has been opposed by the learned counsel for the respondent/State, I am inclined to consider and allow this application.
Accordingly, it is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.

It is also directed that Superintendent of Police and the Collector, Satna shall initiate proceeding for recovery of the amount of compensation from the prosecutrix, if any, paid to her under any of the scheme sponsored by the State or the Central Government considering her to be a victim of rape.
The trial court is also directed to recover the amount of compensation, if any, paid to the prosecutrix under any of the aforesaid scheme treating her to be a victim of rape.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE RAGHVENDRA Raj Kishore Sahu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21878230/
